final_report: The patient presents with severe, recurrent hematologic toxicities (Grade 4 neutropenia, Grade 3 thrombocytopenia, prolonged anemia) indicative of cumulative bone marrow suppression. Advanced age (75-79), ECOG 2 performance status, and obesity (BMI 30.9) further elevate infection and bleeding risks, reflecting poor physiologic reserve and limited marrow recovery, leading to a guarded prognosis.
